statement: Design the Stage32 production-side interface that retains or reconstructs exact 59D reduced Picard witnesses and verified 48-node exceptional support certificates for admissible FULL178 targets, without duplicating EX5's active target-to-59D adapter research.

scope.field_or_model: Stage32 retained production state -> Picard64 / exceptional last48 support
scope.quantifiers: every retained candidate passed to any support-sensitive downstream cut
scope.required_output: minimal exact retention/reconstruction contract, verifier shape, and integration seam to external EX5 outputs

notes: Do not reimplement EX5 BC2-02 FULL178-target-to-59D adapter; treat it as an external producer.
The exact support certificate must not be inferred from scalar exceptional mass e.
